card.name: Page numbers in journal citations
card.fires_on: Punctuation, spaces and digits of page ranges right after a journal name, volume or 'pp.' in reference lists, where the next item is a page number. Also appears at the end of news-related citations.

modes.label: Page range digits
modes.description: Digits inside a page range after a journal volume.

modes.label: Before page numbers
modes.description: The period, space or colon that comes just before the page numbers.

card.writes: It promotes 'news' and 'News' tokens, suggesting news-source or article-title text may come next.
card.plain: It fires inside reference lists, on the spots where page numbers of a journal article are written.
